context: Built v2.0.0-beta.1 scope (V1-V5) on branch v2.0-beta: engines 22.13 + CI 22/24 + prerelease dist-tag routing, auto backend resolution with legacy nudge, SUPPORTED_CONFIG_VERSION=2 with migrate stamps, init stamping, opt-in auto-migrate, upgrade docs. Full gates green (1063 tests, SOAK_SCALE=5).
rationale: The beta flow makes tag/version mismatch a real failure mode (tagging v2.0.0-beta.1 with package.json still 1.24.1 would publish the wrong artifact under the wrong tag); guard fails before publish. Action major bumps clear the Node-20 deprecation annotations and are validated by the same CI run and the workflow_dispatch dry-run.
summary: Publish workflow gained a tag-vs-package.json version guard and prerelease GH-release marking alongside the dist-tag routing; checkout/setup-node bumped to v5
